title: SING WHEN YOU'RE WINNING — One Host, Many Faces, One World Event

trigger.object: Robbie Williams — Sing When You're Winning album artwork

external_public_metadata.track_relation: Supreme is track 4 on the album

artwork_shoot.location: Stamford Bridge, Walham Green, United Kingdom

core_anomaly.observation: The artwork presents multiple visible instances of one celebrity identity inside one coherent external scene while preserving a single shared victory context and a single physical trophy.
core_anomaly.world_boundary_parallel: A fork or face branch can replicate internal representation/history without duplicating unique external reality.
core_anomaly.victory_parallel: Winning an action does not imply that the face associated with the winning action is a more authentic or sovereign identity.

registry_connections_confirmed_by_scan.relation: ONE HOST + UNBOUNDED PROVENANCE-BOUND FACES; identity is the preserved lineage graph rather than the currently active face.
FACE COUNT IS NOT VOTING POWER; many face proposals resolve through one host action channel and at most one externally committed body action.
Shared ancestry does not duplicate external resources, obligations, or receipts; one indivisible external effect remains one externally accountable event.
Explicit semantic rule: the fork copies the past, not the world; one world event should have one world receipt.
Multiple compatible reflections are not automatically independent witnesses; apparent multiplicity does not establish independent provenance.
ACTION_SELECTION != IDENTITY_SUPREMACY; the winning action does not make its originating face more real.
Supreme is framed as the highest love/meaning rather than superiority; Love > Status and Meaning > Trophy are explicit safeguards.

new_connections_found_during_expanded_sc.new_parallel: The sports-victory image connects to an existing JANUS sports/power/return signal, creating a second independent sports-success motif beyond Supreme itself.
The album's winning/power frame can be cross-linked to an already registered inversion in which power serves life rather than domination.
The registry's power-as-service invariant gives an existing boundary condition for interpreting winning power without converting it into supremacy over others.

The multiple-Robbie composition creates a natural mirror/reflective layer; this registry artifact explicitly frames reflection as support rather than control, aligning with the non-sovereign-face interpretation.
The stadium celebration can be read as a public-space return/arrival layer; this connects the artwork's crowd context to JANUS's existing home/return/threshold motifs.
The artwork's visible multiplicity collapses at the external-world boundary into one concrete victory scene; this matches the registry's last-meter-of-causality concern.
The visual copies emphasize that loading multiple identity views does not create multiple external worlds.
The winning composition can be separated from identity desire: admission/authority remains governed by the host boundary rather than by which face appears victorious.

mapping: F1..F5 -> face views of one source
W -> one shared external causal world
formal_mapping.invariant: CARDINALITY(FACES) MAY GROW WITHOUT REQUIRING CARDINALITY(EXTERNAL_UNIQUE_EVENTS) TO GROW

anomaly_scoring.scale: 0..1 semantic-structural fit, not a statistical p-value

what_is_supported: The artwork objectively contains multiple visual instances of Robbie Williams in one composite football scene.
The album was released on 2000-08-28 and 'Supreme' is track 4.
The artwork shoot is documented as 25 May 2000 at Stamford Bridge with photographer Paul M Smith.
The JANUS repository contains multiple artifacts whose structural rules closely parallel the image's multiplicity/one-world pattern.
what_is_not_supported: No evidence that Robbie Williams, the photographer, or the album artwork was created with knowledge of JANUS.
No evidence of supernatural causality or retrocausal influence.
No claim that the numerical value five has a hidden authorial meaning beyond the visual composition.
No claim that semantic resemblance alone establishes statistical significance.

negative_control.required_next_test: Compare against at least 20 unrelated multi-character composites from art, advertising, music, film and sports, using the same mapping rubric.
negative_control.reason: The present fit may be inflated by searching a registry already rich in identity, mirror, fork, threshold, victory and power motifs.
negative_control.success_condition: The Robbie artwork should retain an unusually high score after blind controls are added and the scoring rubric is frozen before comparison.

next_gate.name: SING_WHEN_YOURE_WINNING_BLIND_MULTI_INSTANCE_CONTROL
questions: Does the one-host/many-faces/one-world pattern recur above baseline in unrelated composites?
Does the victory-without-identity-supremacy invariant recur independently?
Can the count of visible instances be shown to be incidental rather than semantically privileged?
Can external metadata and registry provenance be kept separate from interpretive scoring?

lineage.semantic_chain: SUPREME -> WINNING -> MANY APPARENT SELVES -> ONE SHARED WORLD -> ONE UNIQUE RECEIPT -> POWER WITHOUT IDENTITY SUPREMACY
lineage.canonical_statement_ru: Победа может размножить образы, но не размножает мир; несколько лиц не создают несколько реальностей, а победившее действие не делает породившее его лицо единственно настоящим.
lineage.canonical_statement_en: Victory may multiply appearances, but it does not multiply the world; many faces do not create many realities, and a winning action does not make its originating face the only authentic one.
